note: R43 Implementation S1（MSG-20261001-31 CHANGE A + MSG-20261001-32 CHANGE A/B）—— 人工追回提交域的 append-only / 受控变更触发器清单。与 required-triggers.json（租户保护）刻意分离：cc_append_only__* 不得以 cc_tenant_ 前缀命名，以免触发租户清单的反向校验；本清单由 tools/tenant-triggers/emit-check-append-only-sql.mjs 在 CI 显式校验（fresh deploy 与 upgrade path 都跑），不得只靠测试碰巧触发。

triggers.name: cc_append_only__RecoveryPackageArtifact
triggers.semantics: BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE → 拒绝（导出产物不可改）

triggers.name: cc_append_only__RecoveryManualSubmission
triggers.semantics: BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE → 拒绝（提交事实不可改；provider reference 走独立表）

triggers.name: cc_append_only__RecoveryManualSubmissionReference
triggers.semantics: BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE → 拒绝（补录事实 append-only）

triggers.name: cc_append_only__RecoveryManualSubmissionEvidence
triggers.semantics: BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE → 拒绝（证据引用不可改）

triggers.name: cc_recoverypackage_controlled_mutation
triggers.semantics: BEFORE UPDATE → 仅允许 status / supersededByPackageId / transitionReason / transitionActorUserId / updatedAt；核心字段与终态由函数拒绝
